events.author: s_63h0z_rn9tGX5c93aI9sgKHb1iJO4JwP9NvPMuXsE
events.body:
Post !9 merge please publish the MCP and TUI -

1\. Python MCP Server (`blt-mcp`) -\> PyPI

Run the following with `uv` to build and publish:

`uv build`

`uv publish --username __token__ --password <YOUR_PYPI_API_TOKEN>`

---

2\. Rust TUI CLI (`blt-cli`) Binaries

* Automated via GitLab CI : Push a version tag on `main` (e.g. `git tag v0.1.0 && git push origin v0.1.0`). The `.gitlab-ci.yml` pipeline will automatically cross-compile for Linux (x86_64, aarch64) & Windows (.exe), upload them to the package registry, and attach them to the GitLab Release page.
* Manual Build (Fallback):

  `cd blt-cli`

  `cargo build --release`

  \# Output: blt-cli/target/release/blt-cli

---

3\. CI/CD Verification

The **`.gitlab-ci.yml`** file has been updated and tested for multi-platform binary compilation and release asset publishing. Please check the CI/CD pipeline settings to confirm registry and token permissions. I wasn't certain whether automated macOS builds are currently supported in our GitLab runner pool (via GitLab macOS SaaS runners or \`osxcross\` toolchains). Currently, Linux and Windows builds are automated in \`.gitlab-ci.yml\`. Please take a look into that when convenient, and we can update the CI YAML accordingly!

Thank you!

---

Moved from https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-mcp/-/issues/8 (opened by @Nachiket_R on 2026-08-18).

**Discussion summary**

- The `.gitlab-ci.yml` release pipeline described below was deleted in the GitLab retirement; there is no forge release workflow for blt-cli yet (only `.forkmesh/blt-extension--release.yml` exists for another project).
- Owner action: publish `blt-mcp` to PyPI, and decide how blt-cli binaries are built and hosted now.
